policy: Preserve published units and phase boundaries.
Do not infer missing table values.
Keep source table and printed page on every extracted record.
Keep source records separate from PigFlow-normalized models.
Only map Brazilian ingredients to existing PigFlow ingredient IDs when the source ingredient identity is an exact or explicitly documented match.

sourceAnomalies.description: The published 43-49 day phase has average weight 3.713 kg while the published weight range is 3.11-3.70 kg.
The hot-climate table publishes the same average weights as Table 2.28 while using different weight ranges.
Rice bran poultry Met+Cys SID is printed as 0.33% with a digestibility coefficient of 79.9%, although 0.33/0.47 is about 70.2%; FeedSport preserves the printed coefficient.
